title: Key Lime Pie Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: Lime zest, key lime juice and buttermilk replace the strawberries and milk, with broken graham crackers for a pie crust crunch.
summary: All the flavours of key lime pie in a scoop: a tangy lime and buttermilk ice cream with crunchy graham cracker pieces folded through.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt
key lime juice (or ordinary lime juice), fresh or bottled
graham crackers or digestive biscuits, broken into small pieces

steps.title: Lime cream
steps.text: Warm the cream, sugar, syrup, salt and zest in the saucepan until the sugar has dissolved, then leave to cool to room temperature so the zest can perfume it.

steps.title: Add the tang
steps.text: Whisk in the cold buttermilk, then the lime juice. The acid thickens the cream slightly, like a pie filling. Chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Fold and freeze
steps.text: Fold in the biscuit pieces quickly so they stay crunchy, pack into the container and freeze, covered, for at least 4 h.

tips: Bottled key lime juice works well; ordinary limes give a sharper flavour.
Add the lime juice only to cool cream so it thickens rather than curdles.
Top with a little whipped cream and extra zest to serve.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
